faq.question: What does Fatuma mean?
faq.answer: Fatuma is associated with the Arabic form فَاطِمَة, whose core sense is fatuma; fatima (east african form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Fatuma?
faq.answer: Fatuma is associated with Arabic. Fatuma is the East African form of Arabic فَاطِمَة (Fāṭima), the name of the Prophet's daughter.

faq.question: Is Fatuma an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form فَاطِمَة is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Fatuma an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Fatuma can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Fatuma should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Fāṭima is not a Quranic personal name.
